purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It generates monthly business receipt detail files for self-pay and insurance claims, specifically editing and compiling point-score (tensu) requirement lists. It reads indexed files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45, RECE46) and produces formatted output records.

verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in the comments and program description fields. The source is clearly from the open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by the Japan Medical Association (JMA). The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) not shown in the truncated source, so full data division structure cannot be verified. The absence of COMP-3 is notable for a financial application but consistent with the ORCA codebase style. Program ID ORCR0460 matches the filename.
